en:
The best detectives in the world were
alive during the Victorian era...

Have you read many novels about
the detectives of that era?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kirumi for a while?

If you do not mind, would you tell me which
detective from that era you admire most?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I spent some time
discussing detective novels.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi and I grew a little closer today.
